title: Rule 506(c): general solicitation if every buyer is a verified accredited investor
rule: Rule 506(c) allows general solicitation if every purchaser is accredited and the issuer takes reasonable steps to verify it, even for buyers who qualify. Optional methods: two years of IRS income forms; asset statements and a credit report from the last three months; or a recent letter from a broker-dealer, SEC-registered adviser, attorney or CPA. SEC staff says a minimum investment of $200,000 per individual or $1,000,000 per entity, with written representations of accreditation and no third-party financing, can suffice.

citation.authority: 17 CFR 230.506(c); SEC Securities Act Rules C&DIs 256.35, 256.36, 260.07 and 260.39
